# Handover — YYYY-MM-DD — short topic

Keep this under one page. Short sentences. A tired person must get it in 2 minutes.

## What I did

- Bullet points. One action each.

## State of things

- What works now.
- What is broken or half-done. Be honest.

## Decisions made

- Decision + one-line reason. Copy important ones to docs/DECISIONS.md.

## Next steps

1. The single most important next task.
2. Then the rest, in order.

## Watch out for

- Traps, weird data, flaky tests. Anything that will bite the next person.
